messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands facing the ocean, then slowly turns their body and head to the left, briefly revealing their profile before turning back to face forward.","camera":"A static, medium full shot from behind the subject at a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A white sleeveless tank top with a green graphic print near the hem, light green shorts, and pink sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A muscular person with a dark complexion, seen mostly from behind, with a broad back and shoulders.","scene":"An outdoor stone patio or deck overlooking a calm ocean and clear blue sky on a sunny day."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output person now performs a slow, contemplative turn: starting facing the ocean, turning the body and head to the left, briefly showing a profile, then turning back toward the front. The original seaside scene, clothing, hairstyle, body type, lighting, and rear camera framing remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose as demonstrated by the motion reference, while preserving the original person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the subtle hand/arm motion fully matches the reference's thoughtful pose, since the reference is a 3D motion clip and the output is viewed from behind.
unexpected_changes: The output frames appear slightly narrower/cropped compared with the source, with visible black bars on the sides in some frames.
